engineUnavailable: The nftables engine is not available.
notEnforcing: These rules are applied only with FIREWALL_ENGINE=nft. In {{mode}} mode changes are refused; the preview works in every mode.

pending.title: Change applied — confirm it
pending.body: If you can still reach the panel, confirm. Without confirmation the previous rules come back in {{left}} s.

services.title: Services (open ports)
services.intro: Ports reachable on the server, optionally only from given sources.

ipRules.title: IP rules
ipRules.intro: Block or allow an address, on all or some ports, optionally until a date. Allow never opens the panel, database or API ports.

forwards.title: Port forwarding
forwards.intro: Publish a VPN node's port on the server's public address.

egress.title: Full tunnel (internet through the server)
egress.intro: Nodes of the network selected in the sidebar. Enabling it changes the node's config (all IPv4 traffic, DNS 1.1.1.1): download the config again on the device.
egress.noNodes: No nodes in the selected network.

preview.title: Ruleset preview
preview.intro: The nftables ruleset the engine builds from the rules above.

history.title: Change history
history.intro: The newest 200 applied changes. Restoring brings back the rules as they were after that change.
history.confirmRestore:
Restore the firewall rules as they were after this change?

Every rule added since then is removed, including Fail2Ban permanent bans.

live.unavailable: The live view is not available.
live.tableNotLoaded: The nftables table is not loaded (engine mode {{mode}}), so there are no rule counters or dropped sources. Connection tracking is shown below.
live.conntrackUnavailable: conntrack is not available on this host.
live.truncated: Only the first 200,000 entries were counted.
live.droppedIntro: Addresses whose packets reached the default drop of the input chain, up to 4096 per IP family.
live.droppedEmpty: Nothing was dropped in the last hour
live.countersIntro: Packets and bytes each counting rule matched since the last change.

systemRules.unavailable: System rules are shown with the nftables engine (FIREWALL_ENGINE=shadow or nft).
systemRules.title: System rules
systemRules.intro: Rules NovusGate adds by itself. They cannot be edited here; your own services, IP rules, VPN rules and port forwards are left out of this list.

explain.loopback: Traffic of the server to itself (loopback).
explain.blocked: Blocked addresses (Blocked IPs, Fail2Ban permanent bans) are dropped before anything else.
explain.established: Replies to connections that were already allowed.
explain.invalid: Malformed or out-of-state packets are dropped.
explain.ssh: SSH stays reachable on every detected SSH port, whatever the other rules say.
explain.wireguard: WireGuard ports of all VPN networks.
explain.dhcpv6: DHCPv6 replies for the server's own IPv6 address.
explain.adminPortsVpnOnly: Panel, database and API ports are dropped on every interface other than the VPN.
explain.apiFromVpn: The API is reachable from the VPN networks.
explain.panelDbAdminVpn: Panel and database: admin VPN (wg0) only.
explain.recordDropped: Records the sources that reach the default drop (shown on the Live tab).
explain.defaultDrop: Everything not allowed above is dropped by the chain policy.
explain.adminVpnPostgres: The admin VPN keeps access to the database Docker publishes.
explain.dockerPostgres: Docker publishes the database on all addresses; other interfaces cannot reach it.
explain.vpnPolicy: Traffic from VPN clients goes through the VPN rules and network policies.
explain.vpnInboundDrop: Other traffic into the VPN networks is dropped.
explain.sameNetwork: Peers of the same network can reach each other.
explain.egressAccept: Full-tunnel nodes may reach the internet through the server.
explain.egressMasquerade: Full-tunnel traffic leaves with the server address (NAT).
explain.vpnDefaultDrop: Traffic between VPN networks without an allowing rule is dropped.
